Description.Name: Maxim APC
Description.Details: Designed by troops in the field this Maxim variant also transports a squad of battle armored infantry. Unlike the factory version, this version removes the machine guns and ammunition to make room for the infantry bay. It also carries more armor. Originally produced by Maxim Transport Industries, before a series of scandals led to its closure in 3039, the fast and heavily armed Maxim quickly became the model example of a transport throughout the Inner Sphere. Still produced via different companies, the Maxim is still heavily used by many units as their principal APC. It has proven itself popular both to unit commanders, who respect its firepower, speed and ability to carry a full platoon of infantry, and to the troops it carries, who respect its roomy, comfortable infantry bay. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 140 25 Left 140 25 Right 140 25 Rear 100 25 Turret 125 25 Total 645 125 Quirk: Rugged Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads. Has firing ports.

YangsThoughts: The Maxim family of APCs are fairly ubiquitous throughout the Inner Sphere, they are decently armored and armed for their role.
